content: Is Kebpekid-uyun te Megbevayà ki Abram
Ne hein neiwas haazà, mibpekidlalag ki Abram is Nengazen , ke sikandin te, “Abram, kenè ka mahandek, su edlevanan ku sikew wey ebeǥayan ku sikew te utew zekelà he suhul.”

Ne midtavak dutun si Abram te, “Sikew is Nengazen he Megbevayà, wazà igkeveǥey nu kediey he ibmeupiya te ǥehinawa ku su kenè bes egkehimu he egkevuwad a, ne iyan ebpekepengevilin te menge azen ku si Eliezer he tig-Damascus.”
Ne impelaus pa ni Abram is egkeǥiyen din, ne ke sikandin te, “Geina te wazè nu himuwa he mevuwad a, iyan ebpekepengevilin te menge azen ku is suluǥuen ku zà.”
Ne zutun midtavak kandin is Nengazen , ke sikandin te, “Kenà iyan heini si Eliezer ebpekepengevilin su iyan dà ebpekepengevilin te menge azen nu is hustu en he anak nu.”

Ne zutun impeǥawas din si Abram ne ke sikandin te, “Lingehè ka ziyà te langit ne vilanga nu is menge vituen emun egkevilang nu.” Ne ke sikandin daan te, “Iring keniyan is menge kevuwazan nu keuzemà su kenà sikandan egkengevilang.”
Ne zutun, tenged te midtuu si Abram te Nengazen , mid-isip sikandin te Nengazen he metazeng.
Ne zutun migkaǥi is Nengazen te, “Iyan a sikan is Nengazen . Umbe impehendini ku sikew he ebpuun te inged he Ur te menge Kildiyanhen su wey ku ikeveǥey kenikew heini is tanà wey nu maangken.”
Ne zutun migkaǥi si Abram te, “He Nengazen he Megbevayà, hengkey is tuus wey ku metueni he egkaangken ku heini?”

Ne midtavak dutun is Nengazen te, “Uwita nu zini is dumeraǥa he vaka, sevaha he vehiyan he kambing, wey sevaha he meemahan he kerehidu, tigtetelu he tuig is penuiǥen te uman sevaha kandan. Uwit ka zaan dini te sevaha he limuken wey sevaha he merepatik.”
Ne mid-uwit ni Abram haazà diyà te Nengazen , ne mibpemaas heini ni Abram ne imped-atbang din is kedsevuka zin dutun te kada vaas. Iyan dà wazè din baasa sikan is merepatik wey limuken.
Ne zutun duen menge dezekelà he zumezaas he menge tagbis he midlatun dutun te mibaas, piru mibuǥew sikandan ni Abram.
Ne hein edsanlep en is andew, Nekelipezeng si Abram he utew nehurep. Ne neǥezam din dutun is utew subra he kegkahandek.

Ne migkeǥiyan sikandin dutun te Nengazen te, “Tentenuzi nu he is menge kevuwazan nu, ne egkehimu zan keuzemà he menge lumelengyawà ziyà te zuma he nasyun. Egkengeuripen sikandan wey ebpesipelahan sikandan seled te 400 he tuig.
Piru haazà is nasyun he ed-uripen kandan, edsilutan ku ne zutun ebpekaawè dan, ne utew mezakel is menge azen dan.
Sikew mulà, ebpekeluǥeyazen ku is untung nu; ebpatey ka tenged te keǥuǥurangi nu he melinawen.
Ke heepat egkelapis is menge kevuwazan nu ziyà te senge nenasyun, ne human dan ed-ulì dini su wazè pa metuman is timpu te kedsiluti ku te menge Amorihanen tenged te menge salè dan.”
Ne midsanlep en is andew ne mibmerusirem en, ne zuen migkivelat he naahà ni Abram he iring te kuzen he ed-evel wey egkeregreg he ziyà mebayà te pid-elangan dutun te mibaas he imped-aatbang.

Ne zutun he andew, midtukud is Nengazen te kebpekid-uyun din ki Abram. Ke sikandin te, “Ibeǥey ku te menge kevuwazan nu heini he tanà. Puun diyà te wahig te Ehipto pehendiyà te zekelà he Wahig he Eufrates.
Heini he tanà iyan guntaan ed-ubpaan te menge Kinhanen, menge Kinisihanen, menge Kidmunihanen,
menge Hitihanen, menge Pirisihanen, menge Ripanhen,
menge Amorihanen, menge tig-Canaan, menge Girgasihanen, wey menge Jebusihanen.”
